assessment: Trade-update routes are only registered when localTestMode is active and an initialized harness is provided. The local-test config validator requires loopback app/database hosts and rejects Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials.

Payload validation bounds batch count and body size, validates modeled fields, and strips unknown provider extension fields from nested data/order objects; mutation occurs only after the full batch parses.
Observations are application-owned, capped in memory, resettable, excluded from persisted runtime snapshots, and do not affect canonical positions or open orders.
Responses use simulated/PAPER markers and fixed errors. Logs record only accepted count and target, not submitted identifiers/order contents or credentials.
